text: [photo: seating plan draft v3]
Draft v3. Tell me what's wrong with it
ooo 👀 is that mamas table next to andrzejs cousins 💀
Anna the Kowalskis must not sit near the window, Krystyna has been complaining about the draught since May
Looks fine. Is table 4 the one with the bad sightline to the band?
Yes ciocia wanted to be by the bar 🙄 I moved her
Where am I sitting
With us lol. Head table. Obviously
Ok good
The Wiktoria/Marek thing is still open right? They asked about a plus one
Yes they can bring the new boyfriend if he's real Natalia can you check
he's real. he came in for a haircut last week nice guy
Natalia you cannot know that
mamo i literally cut his hair 😭
Venue called, deposit due friday. They need the transfer to the account on the contract, not the one on the invoice
Wait which invoice. I have 2
The one from march. The other is the decorator
Ok I'll do it tonight after work
Deposit is 30% right
30 yes. 9000 something, it's on the contract
I will transfer my share tomorrow. Tell me the exact amount.
Tato I'll send you the exact number tonight
The dress fitting, is it Thursday or Friday? The shop called me and said they have the afternoon free
Thursday 16:00 mamo. I told you on sunday 🙃
Then tell me again on Thursday
i'm coming. bringing the good coffee 🤍☕
[link: rehearsal dinner menu, Miodowa]
Rehearsal dinner menu. The vegetarian option is an afterthought, please look at it
Lol "afterthought" it's a mushroom thing
Is the rehearsal dinner still 14 ppl or did it grow
Grew. 17 now. Ciocia Halina invited herself
17 is fine. The back room seats 20. I checked
Halina is good company if you give her a glass of wine. The wine should be decent, though. Tell them.
Andrzej she is not that, she is loud
Loud is better than quiet at a wedding.
ok who's doing the table cards bc i am NOT doing 140 calligraphy names
I'll print them. Natalia you just do the ribbon
deal 🎀🎀
Fyi the deposit receipt won't show on the venue portal until the bank clears it, don't panic
I'm not panicking. I'm lying in bed panicking
Lol go to sleep
[photo: handwritten sheet music, first dance arrangement draft]
Wait is that the first dance??
It's a draft. Don't tell piotr
wojtek i'm not going to cry at 10pm
Did anyone pay the florist? I can do it tomorrow if no one has
Mamo I'll do it tomorrow, I've got the florist invoice
Going to bed for real. Seating plan v4 tomorrow
